svg.title: Hybrid Pricing Rollout Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-hybrid-pricing-rollout-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Hybrid Pricing Rollout Roadmap; subtitle: Seat base, metered usage and enforced renewal uplift; caption: The seat survives as a base fee wrapped in credits, metered overage and contractual uplifts, with hybrid models posting 105% net revenue retention.; assumptions note: A P90 user can cost five times a P50 user, and AI pulls classical 85% to 95% gross margins toward roughly 50%.; note: Attributed to The Innovation Attorney, Champion Leadership, MonetizeNow, Soft Learn Hub and Willingness to Pay.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Model P50 and P90 Cost per User; deliverable: Cost model against the price point; gate: Hold at least 60% gross margin at P50 users; week: Week 2; title: Fair-Use Policy and Pilot; deliverable: Usage pilot with 5 to 20 customers; gate: Fair-use cap in place before opening usage to the full base; week: Week 3; title: Encode Renewal Uplift; deliverable: Fixed or maximum uplift stored on every quote; gate: Escalator talks open at 7% within the 3% to 7% range; week: Week 4; title: Price In Buyer Meter Controls; deliverable: Alerts at 80% and 100%, rollover, locked overage and a contractual cap; gate: Validated with finance, customer success, sales, product and customers
